description: This file defines utility functions within the Utils namespace, including a file move operation and a function to retrieve the last non-empty line from a string. It includes necessary headers and uses the WPEFramework core classes.

methods.name: MoveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from one location to another by copying its contents and deleting the source file if successful.

methods.name: getLastLine
methods.description: Retrieves the last non-empty line from an input string, similar to shell command pipeline.
